items.title: How many places do you have to edit to add a new display?
items.description: Using the exact two approaches from L3, drag the number of existing handlers that change the count (in the naive version, that's every handler like addFromProductCard and addFromQuickBuy). At 2 existing handlers, this reproduces L3's actual setup before the recently-viewed widget was added.

params.name: existingHandlers
params.label: Existing handlers that change the count
